curriculum: The mainly Dutch-taught Business Administration BSc has a 60 EC common first year and three profiles. Business and Management is the least specialized general management profile and illustrates the generic degree. Appendix 3.1 confirms twelve 5 EC courses. Academic Skills, Business Consulting and Microeconomics appear in the current year-one table. Appendix 3.2 confirms twelve 5 EC second-year courses in management, accounting, finance, operations, organization and research. Year three includes 30 EC of eligible minor or exchange, a 10 EC thesis and four 5 EC courses, including Entrepreneurship Lab. Appendix 12.3 permits earlier Academic Skills I and II and the Integrative Research Project as transition substitutions for students who completed them. Those historic names are excluded from the regular curriculum illustrated here.
progression: The official first-year table progresses from management and academic foundations to statistics, management accounting and microeconomics. The second-year specialization develops organizational theory and qualitative methods, then quantitative methods, operations, research design, market research and strategy. The current thesis catalog requires 60 EC in first-year study and 60 EC of compulsory profile-specific study, as well as degree-program approval before the thesis. The 30 EC choice remains explicit. No particular minor or exchange destination is assumed.
components: Choose a 30 EC minor or approved study abroad.
